scripts.dev:ai: dotenv -e .env -- uv run --directory apps/ai --project . python -m mailpilot_ai
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n web,api,ai -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm --prefix apps/api run dev:serve" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:ts && npm run lint:py
scripts.lint:py: uv run --directory apps/ai --project . ruff check src tests
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:ts && npm run typecheck:py
scripts.typecheck:ts: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace @mailpilot/shared && npm run typecheck:seed && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test:ts && npm run test:py
scripts.test:ts: npm run build --workspace @mailpilot/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace @mailpilot/shared && npm run build --workspace @mailpilot/api && npm run build --workspace @mailpilot/web
scripts.db:ai:migrate: dotenv -e .env -- uv run --directory apps/ai --project . python -m mailpilot_ai.vector_store.migrations
